t.SODIUM_BENZOATE.agn: In the EU it may be used at up to 2.5% (as acid) in rinse-off products, 1.7% in oral care products and 0.5% in leave-on products (Annex V, entry 1). In food it appears as E211.
t.SODIUM_BENZOATE.eff.0: Apart from the regulatory limits there is no substance-specific health warning in the EU. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.SODIUM_BENZOATE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex V, entry 1: Permitted preservative, with an upper limit.
t.SODIUM_BENZOATE.summary: The sodium salt of benzoic acid; a preservative.
t.SODIUM_BENZOATE.what: Prevents the product from spoiling through bacteria and fungi.
